about.title: Campus Health Observatory prototype: staircase records (Kolej MARA Kulim)
about.editing: Edit this file by hand. Use null for anything unknown. Never fill a field with a guess: the map shows null as "not surveyed" or "unavailable".

sources.app: HealthWiz app data (STAIRS list from the original v5.4.3 app); source and method not recorded
sources.f21: HealthWiz Kingdom: Group 14 F21 Full Written Report (v4), Table 2
sources.osm: Not used for staircases: the OpenStreetMap export has no staircases (no highway=steps).
sources.survey: Campus stair survey (shared survey database), export of 24 Oct 2026, with the new stairs ST01 and ST34 to ST38 added from the survey document

fields.angleStatus: calculated from measured step rise and run | from the HealthWiz stair list
fields.orientationDeg: compass bearing of the climb (0 = north), or null
fields.appCategory: the HealthWiz app category (MILD | MODERATE | VIGOROUS), app data
fields.appFloorLabel: floor label from the app data; its meaning is not documented
fields.endpoints/flights/landings/dimensions/ph: reserved for future survey data; null or empty now
